name: Sonix Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Sonix Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the development, design, manufacture, and trade of semiconductors in Taiwan and internationally. It provides main products and development tools, including microcontroller, video/image controller, voice MCUs, wireless video, and Optical ID. The company also engages in the design, development, after-sales service, and wholesale of semiconductor products and related software; and business of computer system integration and technical consulting services. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Zhubei, Taiwan.
